title: Le monde de Krizaka : le courant
logline: A blackout drowns the city in the dark; the flock carries one core of light from wing to wing — through the metro, a skate park and a storm — and plugs the current back in.
theme: Light travels when every craft carries it a little further.
style: Cinematic film still, stylized 3D animated feature film, real-world light and lenses, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, filmic contrast, fine grain, no lens flare rainbows.
keep: One single continuous shot. The characters keep their exact cartoon design, proportions, colours and features, rendered as high-end feature-film CG characters with soft fine feather texture, lit by the scene's own light, with real contact shadows where they touch a surface. Plain unbranded surfaces, no lettering.
keyframeKeep: Keep every character's exact shape, proportions, colours, eyes and features, rendered as soft 3D feature-film CG characters with volumetric shading, lit by the same light as the scene, real contact shadows on the surface they stand on. No text, no logos, no people.

shots.purpose: The hook: a rain-soaked city at night, then every light dies block by block toward us — who brings it back?

No text, no signs with lettering.

shots.keyframe: The crane standing on a low stage behind a DJ table with turntables in an underground warehouse, beams and haze.

shots.purpose: The current is back: neon returns to the city block by block, on the beat.
shots.action: the camera rises over the rooftops as the neon of the city comes back on block by block, then the mast on the tower flares
shots.lighting: neon returning, violet and cyan
shots.plate: Aerial view at night over a dense rain-soaked city of brick warehouses and towers, neon light glowing in violet, cyan and orange, an elevated metro line, a steel lattice radio mast glowing cyan on top of an invented brick tower (no real landmark), mist. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.motion: Aerial crane up over a rain-soaked night city glowing with violet, cyan and orange neon, the radio mast on the highest tower flaring cyan, mist between the towers. Smooth crane up, 24 mm.

shots.purpose: Joy: under a neon sign that blinks back on, the flamingo spins in the rain, splashing the puddles.
shots.action: the flamingo throws its wings open as the neon blinks on, spins on one leg, then stamps a puddle in a burst of spray
shots.intent: the flamingo answers the light, and the city pays back in joy
shots.gaze: up at the returning neon, then out at the city
shots.physics: a spin on one long leg, wings flung wide, spray from the stamped puddle
shots.lighting: magenta neon from the left
shots.plate: Low angle on a wet flat rooftop with deep puddles at night, a magenta neon tube on a low wall to the left casting light from the left and shadows to the right, city towers behind, rain. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.keyframe: The flamingo spinning on one leg in the rain on a wet rooftop, wings open, a magenta neon tube on the left.
shots.motion: Low angle orbit: the pink flamingo throws its wings open as the magenta neon blinks back on, spins on one long leg, then stamps a puddle in a burst of spray. Neon from the left, rain. 35 mm.

shots.purpose: The crafts celebrate: as the work lamps blaze on, the owl and the duck slap a high five over the map.
shots.action: the lamps blaze on, the owl and the duck look up, then they jump and slap a wing high five over the map
shots.intent: the duck builds and the owl reads: their plan worked
shots.gaze: up at the lamps, then at each other
shots.physics: both hop off their feet, wings slapping together, feathers puffing
shots.lighting: every lamp of the workshop on, warm from the right
shots.plate: An underground brick workshop now brightly lit by many hanging lamps, warm light from the right casting shadows to the left, a heavy wooden workbench with a blank map. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.keyframe: The owl and the duck on a workbench jumping to slap a wing high five, lamps blazing on.
shots.motion: Push-in: the lamps of the workshop blaze on, the violet owl and the crimson duck look up, then jump and slap a wing high five over the map, feathers puffing. Warm light from the right. 35 mm.

shots.purpose: The family cheers: on their fire escape, the beaver thumps its tail and the lovebird bounces on its head.
shots.action: the beaver thumps its tail on the grating, the lovebird hops up onto its head, then both throw their arms and wings up and cheer
shots.intent: the family keeps each other close and cheers the city back
shots.gaze: out at the lit city
shots.physics: the tail thumping the metal, the lovebird bouncing, both raising their arms
shots.lighting: neon from the right across the street
shots.plate: A metal fire escape landing on a brick building at night, wet grating, neon glow from the right across the street casting shadows to the left, potted plants, rain. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.keyframe: The beaver standing on a fire escape landing with the lovebird on its head, both cheering at the lit city.
shots.motion: Crane down: on the wet fire escape, the brown beaver thumps its flat tail on the metal grating, the green lovebird hops onto its head, then both throw their arms and wings up and cheer. Neon from the right. 35 mm.

shots.purpose: The score is kept: the magpie lands a flip trick in the bowl as the overpass lights come on.
shots.action: the magpie flips its board under it in mid-air, lands it clean, then rolls out with its wings up
shots.intent: the magpie keeps the score: it lands the last trick
shots.gaze: down at the board, then up
shots.physics: the board spinning under its feet, a clean landing with a clack
shots.lighting: overpass lights from the right
shots.plate: A concrete skate bowl under a highway overpass at night, bright work lights now on from the right casting shadows to the left, wet concrete. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.keyframe: The magpie in mid-air over a concrete skate bowl, its small skateboard spinning under its feet.
shots.motion: Whip pan to the slate-grey magpie in mid-air over the bowl, its small skateboard flipping under its feet; it lands clean with a clack and rolls out, wings up. 16 mm.

shots.purpose: Together, under the light they brought back: the flock on the tower roof, the mast blazing above them.
shots.action: the pigeon lands among the flock on the roof, the falcon claps its back, then they all raise their wings toward the blazing mast
shots.intent: the flock keeps its promise together: the light carried across the city
shots.gaze: up at the mast
shots.physics: the pigeon landing with a hop, wings rising together, rain shaking off
shots.interaction: they celebrate the pigeon's delivery together
shots.lighting: the mast's cyan light from above and behind
shots.plate: Low angle on the flat wet roof of a tall tower at night after the storm, a steel radio mast blazing cyan above, the lit neon city all around, light rain. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.keyframe: Three birds on a wet tower roof — the falcon, the pigeon and the flamingo — raising their wings toward a blazing radio mast.
shots.motion: Low angle, pulling back: the sky-blue pigeon lands with a hop among the flock on the wet tower roof, the orange-red falcon claps its back, then the falcon, the pigeon and the pink flamingo raise their wings toward the blazing cyan mast. Pull back, 24 mm.

shots.purpose: The resolve: the camera pulls away into the clouds over the lit city and the title appears, its dot pulsing like the core.
shots.action: the camera pulls back and up into the clouds while the city glows below, then the mast's light pulses once, slower
shots.lighting: the lit city, a cyan pulse
shots.plate: Aerial view at night high above a vast rain-washed city glowing with violet, cyan and orange neon, a steel lattice radio mast pulsing cyan on top of an invented brick tower (no real landmark), clouds breaking, mist. No text, no signs with lettering.
shots.motion: Aerial pull back and up through breaking clouds above a vast city glowing with violet, cyan and orange neon after the rain, the radio mast pulsing cyan. Slow pull back, 24 mm.
